description: This file defines a partial struct 'Writer<TBufferWriter>' with methods for writing serialization tags related to object boundaries in a wire protocol, specifically for tag-delimited serialization.

classes.name: Writer<TBufferWriter>
classes.description: A partial struct providing methods to write serialization tags for objects and base fields in a wire protocol.

methods.name: WriteStartObject
methods.description: Writes the start object tag with a specified field ID and types, using tag-delimited wire type.

methods.name: WriteEndBase
methods.description: Writes the end base fields tag.
